photos.alt: Compact kitchenette with white cabinets, a granite counter, stainless sink, and a full-size refrigerator beside a warm wood door.
Black paneled entry door with a brass number 3 set in an exposed red brick wall.
Cold Hollow Cider Mill sign at dusk with string lights, apple artwork, and pink winter sky.
Forested Vermont ridge glowing with alpenglow under a pale sky and bright full moon.
Bedroom corner with a charcoal dresser, rustic barn door, walk-in closet, and arched floor mirror against faux brick.
Carpeted stairwell with brick-look walls leading up to a black apartment door under a bright ceiling light.
Loft living area with a wood futon, black coffee table, breakfast bar with black stools, and a skylight in the sloped ceiling.
Aerial view of a red village building and white church steeple against Vermont mountains at sunset.
Red clapboard building with white trim at golden hour, wooden front steps, and a dark door marked with a brass number 3.
Looking up a narrow carpeted stairwell with grey brick-look wallpaper and a wooden handrail toward bright light above.
Drone view of a grey building with a red metal roof, parking lot, and white church steeple in a Vermont valley.
Kitchen counter view toward a black electric range, toaster, microwave, and coffee maker under the loft ceiling.
Open loft living room with a wood-framed futon, coffee table, and four black barstools at a granite breakfast bar.
Bedroom with a made bed, mountain-print pillows, barn-style wood door, and arched mirror on white brick wallpaper.
Bright bathroom with a marble-look tiled shower, black hex floor tile, pedestal sink, and rustic wood door.
Entry nook with a white bench, boots on a tray, and black-and-white landscape wallpaper under a slanted ceiling.
Welcome tray of Cold Hollow cider jugs and a cider donut bag on the granite kitchen counter.
Living area with a sofa edge, coffee table, wall-mounted television, skylight, and barstools along the counter.
Wide view of the loft bedroom with the bed under the sloped ceiling, nightstand lamp, barn door, and arched mirror.
